body: Every limit and behaviour is an option with a documented default (today's value). For a limit, 0 or empty means off or no limit, except where 0 would remove a security protection: that fails at startup naming the option. An option that existed before keeps its zero meaning, and a new no-limit gets its own name (NoLimit, NO_LIMIT). Deliberately fixed behaviours are listed with the reason (docs/reference/options.md and the module's guide). Changes stay backward compatible and ship as patch releases (owner 2026-11-27).
